skill_name: Create a speech that encourages people to donate to disaster relief programs.
workflow: Good morning, everyone. Today, I am here to talk about why it is important for us to donate to disaster relief programs to help those in need. From floods to earthquakes, natural disasters have caused untold damage and suffering around the world. It is our duty as citizens of this planet to do whatever we can to help reduce the burden of these disasters.
